The Movement: The Movement has been winning the hearts and minds of alt-reggae fans since their inception in 2003.Drawing inspiration from Sublime, 311, Slightly Stoopid, and John Brown’s Body, they’ve made a name for themselves as reggae shapeshifters with a foundation of insightful lyrics and heavy drum and bass.
“Kona Dub-Rock.” That’s how Pepper describes their blend of reggae, alternative rock, dub, island rhythms, and punk rock energy. It’s a sound that’s taken the trio from the Big Island of Hawaii — where vocalist/guitarist Kaleo Wassman, vocalist/bassist Bret Bollinger, and drummer Yesod Williams held their first band practice as teenagers in the late 1990s — to the upper reaches of Billboard’s Reggae Albums chart, where 2019’s Local Motion peaked at Number 1.

item.title: Live Jazz Tuesday: Syzygy Trio ∴ Boyd, Sanders & Hall — Tue Aug 25, 7:00 PM — Little Jumbo
item.description: A syzygy is the moment three celestial bodies fall into a single line. It is not a permanent condition. Sun, earth, and moon spend most of their existence scattered across the ecliptic, and then for a few hours the geometry snaps shut and something happens: an eclipse, a spring tide, a shadow crossing a face. Then it passes. Syzygy Trio is built on that principle. Three players, three orbits, and a music that exists only in the intervals when they line up. Jay Sanders anchors the low end on bass and moves to guitar and Erae Touch, a pressure-sensitive control surface that reads position, force, and the smallest lateral drift of a fingertip. It responds less like a keyboard than like a membrane, which means the synthesizer parts breathe and bend the way a bowed instrument does. Will Boyd plays saxophone and EWI, feeding both through an effects chain that can leave a tenor unaccompanied and naked or scatter it into a chorus of itself. item.title: The Science of Happiness: The Four Noble Truths — Sun Sep 13, 10:30 AM
item.description:
Meditation in Asheville: Meditation and Modern Buddhism The Science of Happiness: The Four Noble Truths with Modern Buddhism Teacher Kadam Sharon Lovich
**Sundays 8/16-9/13, 10:30am-11:45am** Whether it’s everyday stress, sadness, or even anger, our suffering can be transformed into inner strength, love, and joy. The first step is understanding its source. In this series, we’ll explore Buddha’s teachings on the Four Noble Truths. The Four Noble Truths are the essence of Buddhist thought and gives us a clear, precise way to understand our life and how to move forward in it. Through teachings and meditation, we’ll discover that suffering comes not from external conditions, but from our own mind. Recognizing this opens the door to transforming our experience and uncovering a more lasting, genuine happiness. Asheville Cuddle Collective Please note- If you want to attend this event you need to purchase a ticket- We advertise in many places and only paid tickets will reserve your space. use the link below to reserve your ticket- https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/sep-25th-an-intimate-evening-of-sensual-connection
What is a Sensual Snuggle Event?\*\* This is a sweet & welcoming event where we practice and use verbal consent to connect and share touch. We talk about boundaries and practice both saying and receiving a “no”. In this space it is common to see people cuddle, share massage, have their hair brushed, kiss, expose nipples, play, laugh, cry, and be vulnerable. This is a sober space where we can relax and connect with other humans who are seeking touch based connection. We strive for this to be a safe event. Safe touch enhances our ability to connect with and trust people. When we are in a space of safety, we are able to relax, feel comfort, and be vulnerable.
**Our Agreements:** 1

item.title: Let’s Craft! — Sat Nov 7, 12:00 PM
item.description:
Queers to the Front! Greetings everyone! Let’s get together and craft while snacking on pie! You can bring whatever craft you’re into, though please don’t bring anything too big/messy (e.g. no mural painting) since we want everyone to have space to work and need to leave the place spotless!
The Baked Pie Company has an ever rotating selection of award-winning pies (as well as quiche and salad); they even have pie flights! They also feature sugar free, gluten free, keto and vegan pies for those with dietary needs. So let's grab a slice of pie and build some community!
Don't worry if you can't make this one, though! It’s a monthly event; you'll have plenty of chances to get your pie on :)
You can check out the menu here: https://www.bakedpiecompany.com/list-of-pies
Source: Queers to the Front!
